It runs preschool programs for ages 1-6, a Parent-Toddler Club for ages 1-3, and Excel extracurriculars (robotics, public speaking, music, art and design) for ages 3-5+, built around a learning-by-doing philosophy. The consumer-facing website (openhouse.school, formerly openhouse.study) is a marketing and enrollment surface; the only network-visible technical surface is a private app backend health endpoint at api.openhouse.study. Openhouse was surfaced as a portfolio company of Accel and added to the API Evangelist network for enrichment. It publishes no public developer API, OpenAPI, SDKs, or developer documentation.

companies.name: Osmo
companies.description: Osmo (Tangible Play) makes hands-on, screen-interactive learning games for iPad and Fire tablet that pair a physical reflector base placed over the device camera with digital games spanning math, coding, spelling, drawing, and problem-solving for children. Backed by Accel and GV, Osmo is a consumer educational-technology brand that sells hardware kits and companion apps direct to families and schools. As of this enrichment pass it does not publish a public developer API, SDK, or developer portal; this profile captures its public web identity and domain-security posture.

companies.name: Pair
companies.description: Pair (formerly Inversity) is an enterprise AI adoption platform that helps organizations build workforce capability in artificial intelligence and measure the return on their AI investment. Pair delivers personalized, hands-on masterclasses grounded in each learner's role, industry, and day-to-day tasks — covering tools such as ChatGPT, Microsoft Copilot, and Claude, plus agentic AI — moving teams from basic AI awareness to measurable adoption. A multi-tier certification path (Fundamentals, Proficiency, Mastery), team adoption dashboards, ROI measurement that tracks time saved and business impact, an AI Showcase for sharing effective workflows, and manager oversight tools round out the platform. Pair is a Seedcamp portfolio company.

companies.name: Pingo AI
companies.description: Pingo AI, Inc. is a consumer language-learning application that uses conversational AI to help learners practice speaking across 15 languages including English, Spanish, French, German, Japanese, Korean, Chinese, Italian, Portuguese, and Arabic. Learners hold real-time voice conversations with an adaptive AI tutor and get a transcript and vocabulary list for every session, following personalized learning paths. Pingo is distributed as iOS and Android mobile apps and publishes no public API, SDK, or developer platform. Backed by Matrix Partners.

companies.name: TEDI
companies.description: TEDI (Tecnologia y Educacion Innovadora) is a Latin American EdTech platform delivering professional training for the construction and engineering industries under the motto "Mejores profesionales, mejores paises." It runs 150+ live and recorded courses each month covering BIM, VDC, Lean management, and project management, plus Autodesk/PMI-aligned certifications, an exclusive construction job board, a professional community, the EDI AI learning assistant, and a TEDICOINS rewards system. TEDI reports 50,000+ certified students across 18+ countries with 150+ expert instructors, and is backed by 500 Global. The company operates a consumer-facing web platform (tedivirtual.com / tedicomunidad.com) and, as of this enrichment pass, publishes no public API, developer portal, or technical documentation.

companies.name: ClassDojo
companies.description: ClassDojo is a San Francisco-based education technology company that builds a classroom communication and behavior management platform connecting teachers, students, and families. The core ClassDojo product enables teachers to share photos, videos, and messages with parents; track social-emotional learning through Points and Big Ideas; manage attendance, timers, and classroom utilities via the Teacher Toolkit; and translate parent-teacher messages into 190+ languages. The platform serves more than 50 million teachers, students, and families globally and remains free for teachers. ClassDojo also offers Dojo Islands (adventure-based learning), Dojo Tutor (math, reading, dyslexia, and ESL tutoring), Dojo Sparks, and ClassDojo Plus as premium experiences for families. The company's revenue model is consumer subscriptions and tutoring; there is no public developer API, OpenAPI specification, SDK, or webhook surface, and the GitHub organization at github.com/classdojo publishes only internal utilities, forks, and policy documents rather than developer-facing artifacts.

companies.name: Illuminate Education
companies.description: Illuminate Education is a K-12 education technology company providing assessment, data analytics, and Multi-Tiered System of Supports (MTSS) tools to schools and districts. Its platform serves roughly 17 million students across 5,200 schools and districts in all 50 states, taking a "whole child" approach that combines academic and social-emotional-behavioral data. Marquee products are FastBridge (universal screening and progress monitoring), DnA (standards-based assessment creation and scoring), and eduCLIMBER (MTSS collaboration and district data management). Illuminate does not publish a public developer API portal or OpenAPI; data exchange runs through education-interoperability standards (LTI 1.0/1.1 Certified, OneRoster, Ed-Fi 2.5+, QTI) and partner/SIS/LMS integrations. It is a portfolio company of Insight Partners, headquartered in Irvine, California.

companies.name: Noon Academy
companies.description: Noon Academy (Noon) is a social learning platform where students study alongside their friends in live, teacher-led group classes. Operated by Noon Tech Limited and headquartered in Riyadh, Saudi Arabia, the company serves more than 12 million students and over 100,000 teachers across five countries, primarily in the Middle East and South Asia. Noon is a consumer education product delivered through student and teacher apps and a web experience; it does not currently publish a public developer API, SDKs, or a developer portal. This API Evangelist profile was created from a 500 Global portfolio lead and enriched with the company's public identity and domain-security posture.

companies.name: Saxbys Coffee
companies.description: Saxbys is a Philadelphia-headquartered hospitality company founded in 2005 by Nick Bayer that operates a small chain of cafes across the U.S. East Coast and Midwest. The brand is unique for its "Experiential Learning Platform" (E.L.P.) — 100% student-run cafes embedded inside college and university campuses. Each E.L.P. cafe is operated by a Student Cafe Executive Officer (SCEO) who takes full responsibility for running the location while earning paid, experiential learning credit. Saxbys describes itself as "a national education company and For Students, By Students" with a mission to "Make Life Better." Saxbys does not publish a public REST API, OpenAPI specification, SDK, developer portal, or partner integration program. The only public digital surfaces are the marketing website (saxbyscoffee.com), location-specific online ordering powered by BentoBox, a "Saxbys Stories" blog, and a mobile ordering / rewards app. The Saxbys GitHub organization exists but currently holds a single internal inventory-analyzer repository. This apis.yml records the company as a non-API hospitality + education brand for the API Evangelist network catalog.

companies.name: University of Bologna Open Data
companies.description: University of Bologna Open Data is a university open-data portal for Italy running CKAN. It exposes the CKAN catalog API over approximately 34 datasets.

companies.name: UPM YODA Open Data Portal
companies.description: UPM YODA Open Data Portal is a university open-data portal for Spain running CKAN. It exposes the CKAN catalog API over approximately 201 datasets.

companies.name: Endless Studios LLC
companies.description: Endless Studios LLC is a game development learning platform where aspiring creators learn to build video games through real, pro-studio projects. Its Endstar game engine lets creators code and collaborate in real time, while structured programs (Launchpad for beginners, Capstone for advanced participants) pair learners with 30+ game-industry mentors, expert playtesting, and collaborator matching across design, art, and programming. Learners build portfolios of shipped games to show potential employers. The company runs university, government, and partner programs (including a UAE national game-making competition) and is a 500 Global portfolio company. It was added to the API Evangelist network as a portfolio lead; no public developer/API surface was found during enrichment (consumer/creator-facing product on the studio.endlessstudios.com app).

companies.name: StudyEdge
companies.description: StudyEdge (Study Edge) is an education technology company that operates an online learning platform for students, delivering video courses, tutoring, and scheduled study sessions through a consumer web experience. The site organizes learning by school and subject with a Courses & Schedule catalog, a Help Center, and paid membership access, and is hosted on the Thinkific course platform with OpenID Connect sign-in for end users. Surfaced as a 500 Global portfolio company and added to the API Evangelist network, StudyEdge is a consumer-facing product with no public developer API, SDK, or developer portal detected during enrichment.

companies.name: Tarefa
companies.description: Tarefa (tarefa.co) is an online study companion — "tu compañero de estudio" — for Spanish-speaking university and high-school students, offering structured learning paths, solved exercises ("ejercicios resueltos"), video tutorials, and practice materials across mathematics (calculus, differential equations, probability and statistics, numerical methods), physics (electromagnetism, Newtonian mechanics, energy), and chemistry (inorganic, organic, gas laws, atomic structure, electrochemistry). It is a subscription-based B2C EdTech platform backed by 500 Global. Tarefa exposes no public developer API or documentation at this time; this profile captures its public web surface and domain-security posture for the API Evangelist network.

companies.name: Academic Partnerships
companies.description: Academic Partnerships (rebranded as Risepoint in 2024) is an education technology and online program management (OPM) company that partners with more than 100 regional public universities to launch, market, and scale affordable, workforce-focused online degree programs. The company provides operational support services including digital marketing, student enrollment and retention coaching, faculty support, and technology implementation, while curriculum, instruction, and degree conferral remain under university control. Its programs concentrate in high-ROI fields such as nursing, teaching, business, and public service. This profile was surfaced as an Insight Partners portfolio company and added to the API Evangelist network; the company publishes no public developer API, developer portal, SDK, or machine-readable API surface at this time.

companies.name: ApartmentList
companies.description: ApartmentList is a U.S. rental marketplace that uses preference-based matching technology and a guided quiz to pair renters with apartments across all 50 states, covering the full journey from search and tours to applications and lease signing. Founded in 2011 and backed by Matrix Partners among other investors, the company operates a two-sided marketplace connecting renters with property managers and landlords, and publishes widely cited rental-market research through its Rentonomics research program. It was added to the API Evangelist network as a consumer-sector company profile; enrichment probing found a production website with SPF/DMARC email protection and TLS 1.3 but no public developer API, developer portal, OpenAPI, SDKs, or /.well-known discovery surface.

companies.name: Career Karma
companies.description: Career Karma is a consumer edtech platform that helps people find and compare career training programs and get matched to the right one based on their goals, learning style, schedule, and budget. Its catalog spans technology paths (coding bootcamps, software engineering, data science, cybersecurity, AI, UX design), skilled trades (CDL truck driving, HVAC, electrical), healthcare, beauty, and sales, alongside rankings, school comparisons, financing guidance (scholarships, deferred tuition, GI Bill), and a resource center of career guides. Backed by GV, Career Karma runs a guided quiz-and-advisor matching experience rather than a public developer API; this profile captures the company identity and the security and link surface probed from its public web properties.

companies.name: Edukita
companies.description: Edukita (PT Edukita Budaya Cinta Belajar) is an Indonesian education company founded during the COVID-19 pandemic by Peter Gumulia and Sean Widjaja on the belief that high-quality education should be accessible to all. It teaches skills that matter through playful but powerful learning, delivering programs online, through six physical learning centers across Greater Jakarta (Bintaro, Bogor, BSD, Depok, Gading Serpong), and blended (Rumah Belajar Edukita). Programs span English with native speakers, early childhood development, Japanese mathematics, and professional upskilling for young students, families, adult learners, and corporate training. Edukita is a portfolio company of 500 Global. It exposes no public developer API surface at this time; this profile captures its identity and domain-security posture.

companies.name: EMERGENCES AI, INC.
companies.description: EMERGENCES AI, INC. (Emergences Labs) builds human competency models, assessment, and training solutions for the AI era, focused on defining the transformative skills whose value compounds rather than erodes as AI advances. Its products include NeoWork, real-world task assessments for recruiting and identifying top performers in AI-native roles and for reskilling; NeoHuman, deliberate-practice training that teaches professionals and students effective human-AI collaboration through real enterprise work; and an expert-curated Data offering of annotated professional workflow trajectories for agent reinforcement learning and domain-specific benchmarks. The company was surfaced as a portfolio company of 500 Global and added to the API Evangelist network. It publishes a public website with research, blog, careers, and legal pages, but does not currently expose a public API, developer portal, or SDKs.

companies.name: Get Lighthouse
companies.description: Get Lighthouse (Lighthouse Lessons) is a management-training and leadership-development company that helps managers run better one-on-ones and grow their teams. It offers bite-sized, actionable online management-training programs, including a 1-on-1 Master Class, Managing Up, and the Secret Habits of Senior Leaders, delivered as self-paced solo study and structured team training, alongside a widely-read management and leadership blog. Get Lighthouse is a content and training provider with no public developer API, SDK, or developer portal; this API Evangelist profile captures its web identity and domain-security posture. It is a portfolio company of 500 Global.

companies.name: Jefferies Financial Group
companies.description: Jefferies Financial Group is a leading global, full-service investment banking and capital markets firm providing advisory, capital raising, sales, trading, research, wealth management, and alternative asset management services to clients across the Americas, Europe, the Middle East, and the Asia-Pacific.

companies.name: NEXT Academy
companies.description: NEXT Academy is a software engineering bootcamp operating across Malaysia and Singapore that trains junior developers through full-time, hands-on coding programs. Its flagship Quantum Degrees cover full-stack web development, frontend, and backend engineering, pairing project-based challenges with personalized mentorship. Founded to help close the region's tech-talent gap, NEXT Academy has produced 2,800+ graduates from 50+ countries, with alumni placed at companies including Google, Uber, AirAsia, Fave, and Mindvalley. It is backed by 500 Global. NEXT Academy publishes no public developer API, SDK, or API documentation surface as of this profile; its primary digital surfaces are a marketing website and a student learning-management portal at lms.nextacademy.com.

companies.name: Sounding Board
companies.description: Sounding Board is a leadership development company offering tech-powered coaching and mentoring solutions that help organizations develop dynamic leaders at every level. Its platform pairs software products (Expand, Guide, and Transform) with a global network of ICF/EMCC/IAC/CCE-certified coaches to deliver 1:1 coaching, group coaching, mentoring, and on-demand leadership development. Sounding Board serves technology, professional services, government, education, healthcare, financial services, and retail organizations, and was acquired by BTS in March 2025 to extend end-to-end executive-to-frontline coaching. Surfaced as a portfolio company of Bloomberg Beta and Canaan Partners; no public developer or API surface has been found to date.

companies.name: Virtual Internship Partners
companies.description: Virtual Internships (Virtual Internship Partners) is a global EdTech platform that connects learners, universities, and host companies to deliver guaranteed remote internships across career fields including finance, legal, healthcare, media and communications, supply chain, hospitality, real estate, HR, and sustainability. Backed by 500 Global, it pairs students and graduates with mentored, project-based work experience at companies worldwide. Added to the API Evangelist network from a VC portfolio and enriched by the pipeline; the company publishes a marketing website and a Rank Math llms.txt but exposes no public developer API surface at this time.

companies.name: Barnes & Noble Education
companies.description: Barnes & Noble Education, Inc. (NYSE: BNED) is one of the largest operators of college bookstores in the United States, operating physical and virtual campus stores alongside digital course-materials and educational services. BNED reaches more than 5.7 million students through 1,125+ physical and virtual stores across higher education and K-12 institutions, primarily through its Barnes & Noble College Booksellers subsidiary and the MBS Textbook Exchange wholesale business. Flagship offerings include the First Day and First Day Complete affordable-access course-materials programs, BNC OER+ digital courseware, faculty adoption tools, campus retail and ecommerce services, and BNC AI Tools. BNED separated from Barnes & Noble, Inc. in August 2015 and is not affiliated with the Barnes & Noble retail bookstore chain. This repository captures any APIs, developer tools, and machine-readable artifacts associated with BNED. No public developer APIs or developer portal have been identified at this time; integrations with campus systems and learning-management systems are delivered through institutional partnerships rather than a public API surface.

companies.name: Ambition
companies.description: Ambition (theambitionapp.com) is a consumer mobile application that helps teenagers get ready for real life. The app delivers short daily life-skills courses and 30-day simulated virtual internships across careers such as entrepreneurship, sales, game design, nursing, and wealth management, where US middle- and high-school students pick a path, build technical and life skills in about fifteen minutes a day, and can earn gift-card rewards for completing an internship. Ambition ships as native iOS and Android apps ("Ambition - Shape Your Future" / "Learn and Earn"); it is a business-to-consumer product with no public developer API, SDK, or documented integration surface as of this profile. This entry was added to the API Evangelist network as a portfolio-lead stub and enriched with the real, publicly verifiable identity, legal, and domain-security surface of the product.

companies.name: Calificadas
companies.description: Calificadas is a Mexico-based, AI-powered human development company that combines artificial intelligence, strategic consulting, and training to help organizations and teams adapt to rapid change. Its tagline is "human infrastructure for the era of artificial intelligence." Its flagship product, CUALY (cualy.tech), is an AI-native platform for developing human capabilities through diagnosis, personalization, and continuous AI-driven feedback across communication, leadership, and collaboration, using voice and video analysis and AI coaches, plus organizational dashboards and iOS/Android apps. The company also delivers organizational consulting, leadership training, and adaptive training programs, and counts Coca-Cola FEMSA, ManpowerGroup, and Alsea among its clients. Backed by 500 Global, Calificadas was added to the API Evangelist network as a portfolio-lead stub. As of this enrichment pass it publishes no public API, developer portal, or API documentation; artifacts below reflect its public web and domain-security surface only.

companies.name: Instacoach
companies.description: Instacoach is an AI-powered baseball training app that generates personalized, on-demand workout programs for athletes across hitting, pitching, arm care, fielding, catching, lifting, and mental performance. Programs are built by college and pro athletes and adapt to the user's equipment and goals, with short guided drills, progress tracking, and stat logging. It is delivered as consumer iOS and Android apps plus a web experience, and also offers team training programs for coaches. Sector: consumer sports/fitness technology. Backed by GGV Capital. No public developer API surface was found during enrichment (no api./developer./docs. host, no /.well-known, llms.txt, or OpenAPI).

companies.name: Outsmart College
companies.description: Outsmart (Outsmart Education, Inc.) is an education-technology company rebuilding higher education for the AI era, aiming to make learning smarter, faster, and more engaging than traditional lectures and student debt. The company is currently pre-launch, operating a public waitlist at joinoutsmart.com, and is backed by Lightspeed Venture Partners. As of this profile the company publishes only a marketing site with a legal Privacy Policy and Terms & Conditions and does not expose a public developer or API surface. This record was surfaced as a portfolio company of Lightspeed Venture Partners and added to the API Evangelist network for ongoing enrichment as any API surface appears.

companies.name: Zhangmen
companies.description: Zhangmen (掌门1对1 / 掌门教育) is a Shanghai-based online education company offering premium one-on-one and small-group tutoring to K-12 students across China. Its platform pairs students with elite instructors and layers on data-driven, intelligent learning analysis: diagnostic assessment, personalized study plans, real-time classroom monitoring, automated learning reports, and parent progress tracking. Beyond core academic tutoring the company runs quality-education modules spanning public speaking, creative art, programming, and comprehensive/mathematical thinking, along with a piano accompaniment-practice product (zmpeilian.com). The business is a direct-to-consumer web and mobile app play delivered in Simplified Chinese; it exposes no public developer API, SDK, or documentation surface. This profile was surfaced as a portfolio company of SoftBank Vision Fund and added to the API Evangelist network for enrichment.

companies.name: Infleqtion
companies.description: Infleqtion is a Louisville/Boulder, Colorado quantum-technology company — formerly ColdQuanta — that builds neutral-atom quantum computers, precision atomic clocks, and quantum sensors for governments, corporations, and research institutions. Its computing portfolio spans Sqale (a full-stack, fault-tolerant neutral-atom quantum computer), Quantum Cores (ready-to-use neutral-atom systems for laboratories), and Superstaq, an open-source quantum software platform with proprietary cross-layer optimization that compiles Qiskit, Cirq, and OpenQASM circuits down to hardware-native operations and routes them across heterogeneous quantum backends. Infleqtion's sensing portfolio includes the Tiqker optical atomic clock, Quantum Spectrum (Rydberg atomic spectrum sensing), and inertial sensors for GPS-denied positioning. The company was founded in 2007 as ColdQuanta, rebranded to Infleqtion in November 2022 after absorbing the Super.tech quantum-software acquisition, and became Infleqtion, Inc. (NASDAQ: INFQ) in January 2026. Superstaq (qiskit-superstaq, cirq-superstaq, general-superstaq) is the only developer-facing public surface; the hardware and sensing businesses are sold via direct engagement and government contracts rather than a self-serve API.

companies.name: AssetWorks
companies.description: AssetWorks is an enterprise fleet and asset management software company with more than 40 years of history and over 1,000 customers across commercial and private fleets, government and public works, and higher education. Its products include FleetFocus fleet and enterprise asset management (EAM), Active Assets fixed-asset tracking, Recoup Ops surplus management, and Scan and Validate mobile inventory management. AssetWorks sells on-premise and hosted enterprise software to large fleet and facility operators; as of this profile it publishes no public developer portal, API documentation, or self-serve API program. This repo is a company profile in the API Evangelist network, backed by Battery Ventures.

companies.name: Babbel
companies.description: Babbel is a Berlin, Germany-based language learning company founded in 2007 by Thomas Holl, Markus Witte, Lorenz Heine, and Toine Diepstraten. It operates one of the world's first online language-learning platforms, offering structured, conversation-focused courses in 14 languages including Spanish, French, German, Italian, Portuguese, Russian, Polish, Swedish, Norwegian, Danish, Dutch, Turkish, Indonesian, and English. The Babbel product suite includes the core subscription Babbel App with interactive bite-sized lessons, speech recognition, and AI conversation partners; Babbel Live for online classes with certified teachers; Babbel for Business for enterprise language training; Babbel Podcasts and Babbel Magazine for supplemental content; and Babbel Videos on YouTube. The company has sold over 25 million subscriptions and reports that 92% of users improved their proficiency in two months, with effectiveness studies conducted by Michigan State University, Yale University, and CUNY. Babbel maintains an additional office in New York City and is privately held. Babbel's revenue model is direct-to-consumer subscriptions (monthly, annual, lifetime tiers) plus enterprise B2B licensing through Babbel for Business; there is no public developer API, SDK, or open-source learner content. The Babbel GitHub organization publishes internal infrastructure tooling (Terraform AWS modules, Puma plugins, OkHttp AWS signing, GitHub Actions) but no consumer-facing API.

companies.name: SVAcademy
companies.description: SV Academy is a tech-sales training and talent-placement organization that runs an intensive Sales Development Representative (SDR) program and places pre-trained, job-ready graduates with employers at no placement fee. It has trained more than 6,000 graduates across the U.S. and Canada and is a portfolio company of 500 Global. SV Academy serves two audiences — job seekers who complete the SDR training program with no prior experience or degree required, and employers who hire and onboard vetted, pre-trained SDR talent. The organization publishes no public developer API surface at this time; this profile was surfaced as a 500 Global portfolio company and enriched by the API Evangelist pipeline from SV Academy's public web presence.

companies.name: TutorABC
companies.description: TutorABC (formerly iTutorGroup) is a Taiwan-headquartered online language-learning platform offering live one-on-one and small-group English and Chinese instruction to learners worldwide. Courses span conversational and business English, Mandarin Chinese, certification-exam prep, and study-abroad advising, delivered through a proprietary web and mobile classroom with matched tutors and partnerships with institutions such as Oxford and Cambridge. The company runs consumer learning sites alongside separate portals for tutor recruitment, learning consultants, and interviewer/onboarding workflows. TutorABC is a portfolio company of Qiming Venture Partners. It publishes no public developer API; this profile captures the company identity, its agent-facing llms.txt, and its domain-security posture surfaced by the enrichment pipeline.

companies.name: Securly
companies.description: Securly is a K-12 student safety company whose platform spans web filtering, device management (MDM), classroom management, and student wellness/self-harm and threat monitoring across the web, email, and cloud drives. Securly is deployed by school districts and integrates with the school technology stack - Google Workspace, Microsoft 365/Entra, Apple School Manager, and Student Information Systems via the OneRoster and rostering standards. Securly's public developer surface is limited and access-gated - it primarily CONSUMES rostering and identity APIs from external systems rather than exposing a documented public developer API. The one provider-exposed API is a credential-gated Securly MDM API used by third-party device/asset systems to pull device inventory and assign or unassign students to devices; its endpoints and base URL are provisioned per tenant and are not publicly documented as a reference.

companies.name: Sentient
companies.description: Sentient (Sentient Labs / Sentient Foundation) is an open-source AI research lab and crypto protocol building Open, Monetizable, and Loyal (OML) artificial general intelligence. Its work spans agent frameworks (ROMA recursive meta-agent, Open Deep Search, EvoSkill agent-skill synthesis), the OML 1.0 model-fingerprinting system for verifiable model ownership and monetization, and the GRID protocol with Sentient Chat as a universal interface for discovering, composing, and coordinating AI artifacts. Backed by Pantera Capital, Sentient publishes peer-reviewed research (NeurIPS, ICML, COLM) and ships its tooling as open-source repositories on GitHub and models on Hugging Face rather than as a hosted commercial REST API.

companies.name: Ossus
companies.description: Ossus builds AI-native intelligence for cultural institutions, starting with libraries. Its flagship product is Ossus ILS, a modern integrated library system that unifies cataloguing, circulation, acquisitions, analytics, and patron discovery in one interface, with an AI copilot that drafts MARC records, subjects, and classifications for librarian approval. A lighter product, Librar, targets school libraries with fast mobile setup. AI add-ons cover camera-based shelf inventory, vendor comparison for purchasing, and grant finding. Ossus emphasizes privacy-first design: it does not train on or sell customer data and works only with catalogue metadata rather than borrower records. Ossus is a Y Combinator (Winter 2026) company based in San Francisco.

companies.name: BeConfident
companies.description: BeConfident (Beconfident Inteligencia Artificial em Idiomas Ltda.) is an AI-powered English language-learning platform that lets learners practice through real-time conversations with AI tutors via text, voice, and video, plus guided 24/7 lessons, grammar and pronunciation feedback, and study plans tailored to proficiency level, with access across web, WhatsApp, and smartwatch. It is a consumer EdTech application backed by Prosus Ventures and operating primarily in the Brazilian (Portuguese) market. As of this enrichment pass the company publishes no public API, developer portal, or documentation surface, so this profile is identity-only.

companies.name: GetSetup
companies.description: GetSetUp is a consumer education platform delivering live, interactive online classes designed specifically for older adults. Learners join expert-led sessions to build digital skills, stay physically and mentally active, pursue hobbies, and connect with a global community of peers. The catalog spans technology how-tos, health and wellness, finance, creativity, and social classes, offered in multiple languages across regions. GetSetUp partners with health plans, employers, libraries, and government programs to make classes accessible. Backed by Cowboy Ventures, it operates a business-to-consumer learning experience rather than a public developer API; this profile tracks its public web surface for the API Evangelist network.

companies.name: Campus Apartments
companies.description: Campus Apartments is a privately held student housing developer, owner, and operator headquartered in Philadelphia, Pennsylvania. Founded in 1958, the company originally served students of the University of Pennsylvania and has grown into one of the largest privately held student housing companies based in the United States, operating over 145 properties across more than 25 states with a portfolio of roughly 70,000 beds. The firm is led by CEO David J. Adelman and operates alongside affiliated brand presence historically associated with the Campus Crest student housing portfolio. Campus Apartments does not publish a public developer API, OpenAPI documentation, SDK, or developer portal.

companies.name: Collegepulse
companies.description: College Pulse is an American market research and data analytics firm that specializes in survey-based insights from college students. Through an online student panel of 800,000+ verified undergraduates across 1,500+ campuses in all 50 states, it has collected 130+ million survey responses and offers custom research, brand trackers, and syndicated reports to brands, media, and nonprofit organizations. Its work is used by outlets and institutions including The New York Times, the Knight Foundation, FiveThirtyEight, Forbes, Dell, GE, and Chegg. College Pulse is a research services company and does not currently publish a public developer API, SDKs, or developer documentation; this profile captures its public web surface and domain security posture.

companies.name: Disrupt
companies.description: Disrupt Technology Venture is a Bangkok, Thailand-based organization focused on building the country's startup ecosystem and developing future-ready business leaders through education, executive training, and venture investment. Its offerings include the House of Talents (HOT) executive leadership curriculum, the Advanced Executive Program (AXP), corporate in-house training, and the Disrupt MBA online course platform, alongside investment vehicles such as the Disrupt Health Impact Fund (deep-tech healthcare) and the Stormbreaker edtech startup accelerator. Disrupt reports 1,500+ program alumni, 20+ corporate clients (including KBank, PTT, Unilever, and Central Group), and that 7 of the top 10 Thai startups count Disrupt alumni among their founders. This profile was surfaced as a 500 Global portfolio company and added to the API Evangelist network. Disrupt publishes no public developer or API surface at this time.

companies.name: Eleqtron
companies.description: eleQtron GmbH is a German quantum computing hardware company founded in 2020 as a spin-off from the Quantum Optics Department at the University of Siegen by Prof. Dr. Christof Wunderlich, Dr. Michael Johanning (CTO), and Jan Leisse (CEO). Based in Siegen, Germany, eleQtron develops freely programmable, scalable trapped-ion quantum computers built on its proprietary MAGIC (Magnetic Gradient Induced Coupling) technology, which controls qubits with microwaves rather than lasers for higher precision and a clearer path to scaling. The company aims to become a leading provider of quantum computing time for industrial applications across chemicals, pharmaceuticals, automotive, logistics, finance, and machine learning. eleQtron's systems are made accessible to developers through cloud platforms and standard quantum frameworks (Qiskit, Cirq, PennyLane) rather than a first-party public REST API. Backed by Earlybird Venture Capital.

companies.name: Givecampus
companies.description: GiveCampus is a digital-first fundraising and alumni-engagement platform built for educational institutions - K-12 schools, colleges, universities, and their affiliated foundations, alumni associations, and nonprofits. The platform provides online giving pages, Giving Days, crowdfunding and peer-to-peer (advocacy) fundraising, matching and challenge gifts, event and volunteer management, donor management and advancement CRM tooling, payment processing, and stewardship and engagement features that help advancement teams raise more money at a lower cost. Founded in 2015 and backed by Y Combinator, GiveCampus is used by thousands of schools and institutions across the United States and internationally. This API Evangelist profile tracks GiveCampus as a company in the network; the company operates a closed SaaS product and does not publish a public developer API, so this record is identity- and infrastructure-focused.

companies.name: MasterClass
companies.description: MasterClass is an online education streaming platform where members learn from a roster of 200+ world-renowned instructors across categories including Arts & Entertainment, Business, Design & Style, Sports & Gaming, Writing, Food, Music, Science & Tech, Home & Lifestyle, Community & Government, and Wellness. Content is delivered as video lessons with downloadable workbooks on web, iOS, Android, Apple TV, Roku, and Amazon Fire TV under Standard, Plus, and Premium membership plans. Newer offerings include MasterClass at Work, MasterClass On Call, and the AI-native MasterClass Executive program. Founded by David Rogier; backed by Atomico, Bloomberg Beta, and IVP. MasterClass exposes no public developer API — it is a consumer edtech product, not an API provider.

companies.name: Presence
companies.description: Presence is a student engagement and co-curricular involvement platform for higher education, now part of Modern Campus. It helps colleges and universities manage student organizations, campus events, involvement and attendance tracking, co-curricular records, forms, and engagement analytics so institutions can attract, engage, and retain learners. Modern Campus serves more than 1,700 colleges, universities, and education providers. Presence is delivered as a closed SaaS product with support and reference code available through the Modern Campus customer support portal; there is no public developer portal, OpenAPI, or self-service API surface published at this time, so this profile captures company identity and probed domain security rather than API artifacts.

companies.name: Rebel Girls
companies.description: Rebel Girls is a global media and publishing brand that celebrates inspiring stories about girls and women, empowering young audiences through books, a podcast, a YouTube channel, apparel and accessories, activities, and the Rebel Girls Sport program. Surfaced as a portfolio company of 500 Global and added to the API Evangelist network for enrichment. As of this pass Rebel Girls publishes no developer, API, or well-known discovery surface: rebelgirls.com redirects to www.rebelgirls.com and every standard well-known endpoint returns 404, and there are no developer/api subdomains. This profile captures the company's public identity and a live domain-security posture probe; it carries no API artifacts because there is no public API to describe.

companies.name: Barnes & Noble
companies.description: Barnes & Noble is the largest retail bookseller in the United States, operating physical bookstores and an e-commerce site selling books, magazines, gifts, and educational products. Barnes & Noble also operates the Nook e-reader platform and offers affiliate and publisher partner programs. No public developer API is currently offered; the company operates primarily through retail channels and affiliate marketing programs.

companies.name: 83 Sciences
companies.description: 83 Sciences is an AI-native materials-discovery company (Y Combinator Summer 2026) that helps research labs unlock value from unpublished and discarded experimental data. Roughly 90% of experimental data never reaches publication; 83 Sciences works on-site with researchers to capture and structure that hidden data into a queryable database, then applies AI-powered analysis and generative models to learn from a lab's full experimental history — including failed experiments — to surface novel materials, co-authored manuscripts, and patents. Founded by researchers from MIT, Stanford, Harvard, and Columbia and based in San Francisco. The company currently ships no public API or developer surface; this profile tracks its identity for the API Evangelist network.

companies.name: Noodle Partners
companies.description: Noodle Partners (Noodle) is a higher education solutions company providing full-funnel services and AI-powered products spanning student recruitment through graduation and workforce development. Its product suite includes the Noodle Learning Platform (a customizable LMS for lifelong learning and continuing education), Noodle Companion (an in-platform AI assistant), Noodle Engage (conversational AI for recruitment and enrollment), Noodle Dialogue (AI-assisted faculty content and curriculum design), and Noodle Manage (data integration and analytics). Noodle also delivers marketing, enrollment, learning design, retention, and strategic consulting services to universities. It was surfaced as a portfolio company of 500 Global and added to the API Evangelist network. No public developer API surface was found during enrichment; the company publishes a SOC 2 trust center.

companies.name: YOURIKA
companies.description: YOURIKA (YOURIKA Labs) is a Kitchener-Waterloo, Canada AI platform and venture studio that creates and scales purpose-built, verticalized AI ventures in partnership with industry experts, prioritizing accuracy, trust, and measurable outcomes over technology-first approaches. Its ventures include smart'n, a nurse-first intelligence and learning platform that helps nurses learn, grow, and make more informed decisions throughout their careers, and Retain / Workforce Intelligence for senior and long-term care, which helps operators identify, hire, and retain caregivers while reducing turnover. yourikaLABS also offers AI advisory services connecting businesses with experts to build data-driven strategies and roadmaps. YOURIKA is backed by Amazon, Techstars (Amazon Alexa Accelerator), and the University of Waterloo. The company exposes no bespoke public developer API; its marketing site is built on Wix and advertises a Wix Site MCP endpoint plus an llms.txt for agentic access.

companies.name: Bio-Rad Laboratories
companies.description: Bio-Rad Laboratories is a global leader in developing and manufacturing a wide range of products for the life science research and clinical diagnostic markets, including instruments, reagents, consumables, software, and services. Founded in 1952, Bio-Rad serves scientists in genomics, proteomics, cell biology, quality control, and clinical diagnostics with products like real-time PCR systems, western blotting instruments, flow cytometers, and digital PCR.

companies.name: Coded
companies.description: CODED is a Kuwait-based coding education and technology skills company offering hands-on bootcamps and programs for adults, youth, and kids. Its adult bootcamps cover Cybersecurity, Agentic AI, AI & Data Science, and AI App Development, while youth tracks (ages 14-24) and kids programs (ages 6-13) build foundational and career-oriented tech skills through projects, coaching, and real-world standards. CODED also delivers custom enterprise training for corporate teams. Surfaced as a 500 Global portfolio company and added to the API Evangelist network; CODED is an education provider and publishes no public developer API, SDKs, or specifications.

companies.name: Pluralis
companies.description: Pluralis Research is a decentralized AI lab pioneering Protocol Learning, a third path between closed proprietary models and open-weight models in which large transformer models are collaboratively pre-trained across many low-bandwidth, geographically distributed consumer GPUs without any single participant holding the full model weights. Its work spans communication-efficient model parallelism, asynchronous pipeline-parallel optimization, and community-owned training runs (Agora, node0), published as research papers at NeurIPS, ICML, and ICLR and as open-source libraries. Pluralis is backed by Union Square Ventures. It exposes research libraries, a participation CLI, and live run dashboards rather than a conventional REST/GraphQL developer API.

companies.name: Marker Learning
companies.description: Marker Learning is a special-education technology company that provides AI-powered report-writing tools for school districts and evaluation teams. Its platform ingests referral and assessment documents and automatically drafts comprehensive psychological and educational evaluation reports, citing its sources for transparency, supporting multiple assessment and rating scales, and running built-in compliance checks. The company emphasizes FERPA and NIST CSF compliance. Marker Learning was surfaced as a portfolio company of a16z and added to the API Evangelist network. As of this enrichment pass it publishes no public API, developer portal, or API documentation.

companies.name: Talk Labs
companies.description: Talk Labs (TalkLabs) builds AI-powered voice simulations for corporate learning, turning training theory into practical, hands-on skills. Its platform provides AI trainers that role-play realistic customer scenarios so frontline sales and customer-service staff can practice conversations on demand. Capabilities include 24/7 AI coaching with no capacity limits, voice-based simulations in 50+ languages, progress-tracking and analytics dashboards, LMS integration, and a no-code AI lesson builder, with deployment within a week of contract. It serves banks, retail, hospitality, financial services, and restaurants. Backed by 500 Global and founded by Serge Sarkisian (CEO) and Ilia Krotov (CTO). No public API, developer portal, documentation, or well-known discovery surface was found at the time of this profile.

companies.name: Center for Parent Information and Resources
companies.description: The Center for Parent Information and Resources (CPIR) is a federally funded central hub of information and products for the national network of Parent Training and Information Centers (PTIs) and Community Parent Resource Centers (CPRCs). CPIR supports families and youth, with a focus on children and youth with disabilities, delivering resources via the Parent Center Hub website, the Buzz from the Hub newsletter, and an events calendar. No public developer API has been identified; content and updates are delivered through website browsing, newsletter subscription, and an embedded Google Calendar.

companies.name: Magoosh
companies.description: Magoosh is an online test-preparation company serving over 10 million students across 185 countries with affordable, self-paced courses for the GRE, GMAT, SAT, ACT, TOEFL, IELTS, MCAT, and LSAT. Its platform pairs expert-crafted practice questions, video lessons, and detailed explanations with progress tracking, flashcard tools, AI-assisted tutoring, and iOS/Android apps, plus school and district plans. Magoosh publishes a marketing website and a company blog but exposes no public developer API, developer portal, or API documentation; this profile captures its public web footprint and domain security posture.

companies.name: Pramaana Labs
companies.description: Pramaana Labs is a frontier AI research lab building the verification layer for high-stakes, mission-critical AI. The company turns complex human knowledge - tax codes, clinical guidelines, legal rules, and safety constraints - into machine-checkable logic, so that every AI answer can be traced, challenged, and proved rather than merely sounding plausible. Its stack compiles domain rules into formal systems that return proofs, counterexamples, and traceable explanations. Pramaana Labs raised $27M to build a compiler for mission-critical AI and is backed by Accel. At this time the company operates as a research lab with published work (RuleArena, arXiv) and no public developer API surface.

companies.name: Swiss Education Group
companies.description: Swiss Education Group (SEG) is a Montreux-based alliance of internationally celebrated hospitality, business, and culinary arts schools in Switzerland, comprising Cesar Ritz Colleges, Culinary Arts Academy Switzerland, Swiss Hotel Management School, and HIM Business School. Across five campuses it educates more than 6,000 students from over 110 nationalities in hospitality management, culinary arts, and business. It was surfaced as a portfolio company of idg-capital and added to the API Evangelist network for enrichment. As of this pass SEG publishes no public developer portal, API documentation, SDKs, or machine-readable API surface; this profile is maintained as a company/identity record rather than an API provider.

companies.name: Picasso
companies.description: Picasso is an image downloading and caching library for Android, focused on simplicity and minimal disk space usage. It is an open-source project by Square. Picasso is a client-side library, not a hosted HTTP API.

companies.name: Clue (BioWink)
companies.description: Clue, operated by BioWink GmbH in Berlin, Germany, is a science-driven menstrual, ovulation, pregnancy, and reproductive health tracking app with 100M+ downloads across 190+ countries. The product portfolio spans Clue (free tier), Clue Plus (subscription), Clue Conceive, Clue Pregnancy, Clue Perimenopause, and a "Clue (No Period)" mode for non-bleeding hormonal cycles. Clue Connect provides partner sharing. The company contributes anonymized real-world data to academic research partnerships with Stanford, University of Oxford, UC Berkeley, MIT, and the Bill & Melinda Gates Foundation. Clue is a consumer mobile product; no public developer API or partner API portal has been identified. This entry catalogs the company surface for the API Evangelist index.

companies.name: 51Talk
companies.description: 51Talk is an online English-language education platform that connects learners with certified teachers through one-on-one live video lessons. Founded in 2011 and listed on the NYSE, the company operates across 90+ countries with a large base of accredited teachers, delivering a structured curriculum and ready-made teaching materials for both children and adult learners. Following a strategic shift, 51Talk focuses on international markets outside mainland China, including the Philippines and the broader Southeast Asia region, and recruits teachers globally. It is a consumer education company backed by DCM Ventures; as of this profile it publishes no public developer API, SDK, or documentation surface, so this repo carries only identity and domain-security signals.

companies.name: Epic! Creations
companies.description: Epic! Creations, Inc. operates Epic, an award-winning digital reading and learning platform for children twelve and under. The service gives families and educators unlimited access to a library of more than 40,000 books, audiobooks, and learning videos, with reading-level personalization, quizzes, and progress tracking. Epic offers a consumer family subscription and Epic School, a version that is free for teachers and students during the school day via class codes. The company was surfaced as a portfolio company of Battery Ventures and added to the API Evangelist network. Epic is a business-to-consumer application and does not publish a public developer program, API, or SDK surface.

companies.name: Google NotebookLM
companies.description: Google NotebookLM is an AI-powered research and thinking partner that helps users analyze, summarize, and explore sources such as documents, PDFs, web pages, and notes. It leverages Google's Gemini models to ground responses in user-provided source material, generating summaries, study guides, FAQs, and Audio Overviews. NotebookLM does not currently expose a public API; integration with the service is limited to the web interface and supported Google Workspace contexts.

companies.name: Ilumno
companies.description: Ilumno is a Latin American education technology company that helps higher education institutions grow and modernize through digital transformation. Its services span student acquisition and retention (Growth), online and virtual learning platforms (Virtuality), and real-time analytics and student-data management tools, all delivered on its Growth Engine technology platform. Ilumno reports supporting more than 220,000 students across the region, with offices in Bogota (Colombia), Dallas (USA) and Amsterdam (Netherlands). The company is backed by Insight Partners.

companies.name: Playbook
companies.description: Playbook is a career-growth platform for women that combines expert-led Masterclasses with an engaged professional community, enabling members to keep learning, build skills, and advance into leadership roles. Its tagline "Connect, Learn, Invest" reflects a focus on peer connection, ongoing education, and investing in one's own career. Playbook is backed by 500 Global and Bain Capital Ventures. As of this profile the company operates a consumer marketing and community web experience and does not publish a public developer API, SDKs, or developer documentation.

companies.name: Respondus
companies.description: Respondus builds assessment-integrity tools for online exams - most notably LockDown Browser, a custom browser that locks down the testing environment, and Respondus Monitor, an automated webcam-based online proctoring service that adds AI-assisted review on top of LockDown Browser. Over 2,000 institutions across 50+ countries use Respondus to deliver hundreds of millions of online exams a year. Respondus does not publish a self-service public developer API. Its products reach learning platforms through LMS integration rather than an open REST surface - native plugins/building blocks plus the IMS Global LTI (Learning Tools Interoperability) standard for Blackboard, Brightspace, Canvas, Moodle, Sakai, and Schoology, and a privately-licensed LockDown Browser SDK for third-party assessment platforms that must be arranged through Respondus sales. No public OpenAPI, developer keys, or documented endpoints are offered.

companies.name: The Cru
companies.description: The Cru (now branded "The Cru Empowered by Luminary") is a membership community founded by Tiffany Dufu that matches women and allies into small peer-coaching accountability circles ("Crus") of 6-8 members who meet in monthly 90-minute gatherings to advance their personal and professional goals. It was acquired by Luminary, a New York City based professional community and coworking organization, and the thecru.com site now redirects to weareluminary.com/luminary-crus. This is a consumer community and coaching business, not a technical platform - it publishes no public API, developer portal, or SDK surface.

companies.name: Authorea
companies.description: Authorea is a collaborative online platform for writing, editing, reviewing, and publishing scholarly and scientific documents. Founded in 2012 by Alberto Pepe and Nathan Jenkins, it lets researchers co-author articles in rich text or LaTeX, manage citations and references, embed data, figures, and code, run version-controlled review, and export to journal-specific styles. Authorea was acquired by Atypon in 2018 and is now operated as part of John Wiley & Sons, hosted on Atypon's Literatum publishing platform, where it supports preprints, journal submission, and open collaboration for the research community. It has no public developer API today; its earlier REST API was retired after the Wiley/Atypon acquisition, and the GitHub organization now publishes only document-processing tooling (LaTeXML, Pandoc, TeX styling) rather than API client SDKs.

companies.name: Examity
companies.description: Examity is an online exam proctoring and test integrity platform used by universities, certification bodies, and enterprises to authenticate test-takers and monitor online assessments. It offers automated (AI/ML) proctoring, live proctoring, audit-based review, and ID verification, and integrates with learning management systems (Canvas, Blackboard, D2L Brightspace, Moodle, Sakai, Schoology, and others). Examity's programmatic surface is a partner/LMS integration - single sign-on via IMS LTI (consumer key plus shared secret) and a partner integration REST API that platform vendors use to register exams, schedule proctoring appointments, launch sessions, and retrieve completion status and integrity flags. Access is gated - there is no public self-service developer portal, and integration keys plus the integration manual are provided on request via developers@examity.com. Because no endpoints are publicly documented, the APIs below are modeled from the known integration model rather than a published reference.

companies.name: Anki
companies.description: Anki, Inc. was a consumer robotics and artificial-intelligence company based in San Francisco, founded in 2010 and backed by Andreessen Horowitz, Index Ventures, and J.P. Morgan. It was known for the Cozmo and Vector companion robots and the Anki Drive / Overdrive robotic racing system, which combined computer vision, on-device AI, and mapping/navigation. Anki debuted at Apple's WWDC in 2013, shipped Cozmo in 2016 and Vector in 2018, and published first-party Python and C# SDKs so developers could program the robots over a local connection. Anki ceased operations in May 2019 and its assets were later acquired by Digital Dream Labs. This profile was surfaced as a portfolio company of a16z and enriched by the API Evangelist pipeline; the robot SDKs remain the company's public developer surface.

companies.name: Duolingo
companies.description: Duolingo (NASDAQ: DUOL) is a Pittsburgh, Pennsylvania based learning technology company best known for the Duolingo language-learning app, the world's most-downloaded education app, offering courses in more than 40 languages including Spanish, English, French, German, Italian, Portuguese, Japanese, and Chinese. Founded in 2011 by Luis von Ahn and Severin Hacker, Duolingo has expanded its consumer learning footprint beyond languages with Duolingo Math, Duolingo Music, a newly rolled-out Chess course, and Duolingo ABC for early literacy, all delivered through the same gamified, streak- driven mobile experience. The Company also operates the Duolingo English Test, a digital English-proficiency exam accepted by thousands of higher- education institutions, certification programs, and government agencies worldwide as an alternative to TOEFL and IELTS. Duolingo monetizes through Super Duolingo and Duolingo Max subscriptions, in-app advertising, in-app purchases, and Duolingo English Test fees. The company surpassed 50 million daily active users in Q3 2025 and reported 41% revenue growth in Q2 2025. Duolingo does not publish an official public developer API, SDK, or developer portal; integrations with the Duolingo English Test (score-send to institutional CRMs such as Slate) are handled through a private API-key program negotiated directly with accepting institutions. Community- maintained reverse-engineered clients exist against the unofficial https://www.duolingo.com/api/1 surface but are not endorsed by Duolingo.

companies.name: Kano Computing
companies.description: Kano Computing is a London-based technology company founded in 2013 by Alex Klein, Saul Klein and Yonatan Raz-Fridman that began by shipping build-it-yourself computer and coding kits designed to teach STEM and creative computing to children on top of Raspberry Pi hardware. Its catalog spanned the Kano Computer Kit, motion-sensor and Harry Potter / Star Wars coding wands, the Windows-based Kano PC built with Microsoft, and the Stem Player and Stem Video Projector consumer devices. Kano paired the hardware with Kano Code, a block-to-text creative-coding platform, and Kano World, an online making and sharing community. The company entered administration in 2023 and its assets now trade under the Stem brand; its developer footprint survives as open-source tooling in the KanoComputing GitHub organization and the npm @kano scope rather than a hosted API.

companies.name: Microverse
companies.description: Microverse is an online education platform that trains people worldwide to become remote software developers, founded by Ariel Camus with the stated mission of connecting one million people to remote jobs by 2030. Its model pairs students across time zones for peer collaboration that mirrors distributed engineering teams, and it historically charged tuition only after graduates secured a job. Microverse also runs Leap, an English-practice platform for developers. It is a private, distributed company backed by investors including Y Combinator, Hack.VC, and General Catalyst. Microverse does not currently publish a public developer API, SDKs, or API documentation; this profile captures its public web presence and security posture.

companies.name: National Institute of Mental Health
companies.description: The National Institute of Mental Health (NIMH) is the lead federal agency for research on mental disorders. NIMH conducts and supports research that seeks to understand, treat, and prevent mental illness, working to transform the understanding and treatment of mental illness.

companies.name: Polyup
companies.description: Let'sMOD (formerly Polyup) is a Sunnyvale, California company founded in 2015 that builds a consumer platform where users aged 8 and up can play, modify, remix, and share short 3D microgames and AI-powered interactive memes. Originally a computational-thinking and math learning tool under the Polyup brand, the product has evolved into a generative-AI-driven microgame and viral-content community at letsmod.com. Let'sMOD is a 500 Global portfolio company. It exposes no public developer API, SDK, or developer portal today; its public GitHub organization contains only internal CLI tooling and configuration. This profile was added to the API Evangelist network as a portfolio lead and enriched via live domain-security probing.

companies.name: Duane Morris
companies.description: Duane Morris LLP is a Philadelphia-headquartered, full-service U.S. and international law firm founded in 1904 by Russell Duane, Steven Heckscher, and Roland S. Morris. Chaired by Matthew A. Taylor, the firm describes itself as "a law firm with more than 900 attorneys in offices across the United States and internationally" — with a U.S. footprint spanning the East Coast, Texas, the Mountain West, and California, plus international offices in London, Singapore, Vietnam (Hanoi, Ho Chi Minh City), Shanghai, Myanmar, and joint ventures/alliances reaching Mexico and Latin America. An Am Law 100 firm since 2001, Duane Morris is known for depth in intellectual property (including patent prosecution and PTAB practice), trial and appellate litigation, real estate, corporate transactions, employment, healthcare, cannabis, and life sciences. The firm publishes an extensive LexBlog-powered thought-leadership network of more than 50 practice-area blogs, all of which expose RSS 2.0 feeds via the standard WordPress /feed/ convention. Duane Morris does not expose any public developer API, SDK, OpenAPI/AsyncAPI spec, GraphQL endpoint, webhooks, status page, or developer portal; the GitHub organization github.com/duanemorris exists but has no public repositories. The firm's only machine-readable surfaces are the RSS feeds of its blog network.

companies.name: Sophont
companies.description: Sophont is a frontier medical AI lab (est. 2025) building open, universal, multimodal foundation models for medicine, working toward open medical superintelligence for clinicians. Its open-weight models are evaluated publicly and built with the research community (in collaboration with MedARC), spanning computational pathology (OpenMidnight and the nanopath challenge), functional MRI (CortexMAE), fMRI vision decoding (Brainmarks), and clinical-text benchmarks (Medmarks). Sophont aims to unify every modality of patient data (clinical notes, labs, imaging, pathology, physiological signals, genomics, medications, and demographics) into a single model of patient state to model disease trajectory, predict intervention response, and accelerate biomedical research. Backed by Kindred Ventures. Enrichment note (2026-07-21) — Sophont is a research lab that publishes open model weights, benchmarks, and papers; it does not currently expose a public developer API, OpenAPI, SDK, or docs portal.

companies.name: Apollo Education Group
companies.description: Apollo Education Group is a private education provider that operates the University of Phoenix and other institutions offering associate's, bachelor's, master's, and doctoral degree programs. The organization focuses on providing accessible higher education to working adult learners through online and in-person formats.

companies.name: igetget
companies.description: igetget is the English name for 得到 (Dedao), a Chinese knowledge-service and lifelong-learning platform operated by Beijing Siwei Zaowu Information Technology Co., Ltd. (北京思维造物信息科技股份有限公司), the company behind Luojisiwei (罗辑思维) founded by Luo Zhenyu. The app sells curated courses, expert lectures, ebooks, and audiobooks across finance, economics, law, management, psychology, and self-improvement, alongside an enterprise edition, a web edition, and the annual "Time's Friend" (时间的朋友) New Year's Eve lecture. It is a consumer content product; enrichment found no public API specification or developer documentation, only an open-platform (开放平台) login surface at open.igetget.com. Backed by Qiming Venture Partners.

companies.name: Joint Fire Science Program
companies.description: The Joint Fire Science Program (JFSP) funds scientific research on wildland fires and distributes results to help policymakers, fire managers and practitioners make sound decisions. Operated jointly by the U.S. Departments of the Interior and Agriculture, JFSP coordinates the Fire Science Exchange Network across regional knowledge nodes. JFSP does not publish a self-service developer portal or OpenAPI; research outputs are surfaced through the firescience.gov website.

companies.name: Job Corps
companies.description: Job Corps is the nation's largest free residential education and job training program for young adults, operated by the U.S. Department of Labor. It helps eligible young people ages 16 through 24 improve the quality of their lives through vocational and academic training across 100+ training areas, 10 in-demand industries, and 120+ campuses nationwide.

companies.name: Oak Ridge National Laboratory
companies.description: Oak Ridge National Laboratory (ORNL) is the largest US Department of Energy science and energy laboratory. ORNL provides public data and scientific computing resources for research including neutron science, materials science, computing, energy, and national security.

companies.name: Opencurriculum
companies.description: OpenCurriculum is a nonprofit education-technology organization (a Y Combinator alum) that builds curriculum-planning software for K-12 schools. Its web application helps teachers and administrators create and organize lesson plans, unit plans, and courses; draw on a curated library of high-quality, ready-to-go teaching ideas, resources, and strategies; align instruction to standards and learning goals; collaborate with colleagues on instructional design; and track progress through planner, calendar, and semester views with alignment analytics. The organization is based in Sacramento, California. As of this enrichment pass OpenCurriculum publishes no public API, developer portal, SDK, OpenAPI specification, webhooks, or /.well-known discovery surface; it maintains a small public GitHub organization (one public repository, "flow", an open-source learning-app maker). This profile therefore carries company identity only, with no API artifacts to enrich.

companies.name: Generalist
companies.description: Generalist (Generalist AI) is a frontier AI research and product company building general intelligence for the physical world — embodied foundation models that train general-purpose robots to perform real-world physical tasks with human-level dexterity. Founded in 2024 by researchers drawn from OpenAI, Google DeepMind, and Boston Dynamics (contributors to PaLM-E, RT-2, Gemini Robotics, Atlas, Spot, and the scaling of ChatGPT and GPT-4), the company has released GEN-0 and GEN-1 — large multimodal embodied models that emit robot actions in real time across factories, warehouses, laboratories, restaurants, farms, homes, and space applications. GEN-1 is positioned as the first general physical AI model to cross a commercial-viability threshold. Generalist raised $400M in 2026 at roughly a $2B valuation ($500M+ total). It operates from the San Francisco Bay Area and Boston and, as of this profile, publishes no public developer API, SDK, or documentation surface.

companies.name: Já Entendi
companies.description: Já Entendi is a Brazilian corporate-education (EdTech) company based in Curitiba that converts traditional corporate training materials into short, video-based online courses designed for workforces with lower levels of formal education. Its learning platform combines andragogy, heutagogy, storytelling, neurolinguistics, instructional design, and mind mapping to deliver more effective learning, offering both custom-built training solutions for large employee bases with sensitive or confidential content and a catalog of ready-made courses, all with integrated video lessons, assessments, and exercises. The company reports 1.2M+ students, 100+ courses, and 1,600+ videos delivered. Backed by 500 Global. No public developer portal, API, or SDK is published.

companies.name: Metafy
companies.description: Metafy is a consumer marketplace for gaming coaching and mentorship, connecting players with expert coaches and professional gamers for personalized one-on-one lessons, VOD reviews, and guides across popular competitive titles. Metafy operates a consumer web platform at metafy.gg and, as of this enrichment pass, publishes no public developer API, developer portal, or API documentation; the only machine-discoverable surface found was an RFC 9116 /.well-known/security.txt security contact. Surfaced as a portfolio company of dcm-ventures.

companies.name: Safe Superintelligence
companies.description: Safe Superintelligence Inc. (SSI) is an AI research lab founded in 2024 by Ilya Sutskever, Daniel Gross, and Daniel Levy, with offices in Palo Alto and Tel Aviv. The company describes safe superintelligence as its single mission, sole focus, and "entire product roadmap," and is assembling a lean team of engineers and researchers dedicated to it and nothing else. SSI raised $1B in a Series A from NFDG, a16z, Sequoia, DST Global, and SV Angel; Ilya Sutskever serves as CEO and Daniel Levy as President. The company publishes no public API, developer platform, or technical documentation as of this enrichment pass — this profile captures its identity and domain security posture.

companies.name: Springboard
companies.description: Springboard is an online education company offering mentor-led, career-focused bootcamps and courses in software engineering, data science, data analytics, UX/UI design, cybersecurity, and machine learning. Programs pair a structured, self-paced curriculum with 1:1 industry mentorship, career coaching, and a job guarantee on eligible tracks. Springboard was surfaced from a 500 Global portfolio list and added to the API Evangelist network for enrichment; it operates as a consumer/B2B learning platform and does not currently publish a public developer API, so this profile carries identity and security-posture signals rather than API artifacts.

companies.name: Until
companies.description: Until (Until Labs) is a biotechnology company building the medical infrastructure to pause biological time. It is developing reversible cryopreservation systems for human organs, starting with organ-scale reversible cryopreservation to solve the donor-organ procurement and matching problem, and methodically scaling toward whole-body preservation. The lab translates the fundamentals of cryobiology into engineered workflows across five dimensions — perfusion, cryoprotectants, cooling, rewarming, and organ health assessment — using vitrification (glass, not ice) to prevent ice formation during preservation and safe rewarming. Founded by Laura Deming and Hunter Davis, Until has raised $100M+ to date and is backed by Founders Fund. Until is a research-and-development company with no public API surface; this profile captures its identity and public web properties for the API Evangelist network.

companies.name: Collegevine
companies.description: CollegeVine is a Cambridge, Massachusetts company, backed by Menlo Ventures, that has repositioned itself as "the AI operating system for universities." Its platform pairs automated ingestion of data from campus systems (a Data layer) with a unified Ontology of institutional operations and an AI Operations layer of agents, applications, and ML models that connect directly to a university's CRM and admissions workflows. CollegeVine also operates a large consumer-facing college-admissions guidance property (chancing engine, essay guidance, and an AI counselor) at collegevine.com and blog.collegevine.com. As of this profile the company exposes no public developer API, OpenAPI specification, developer portal, or published SDK for its product; engagement is enterprise sales and demo driven. It does maintain an active public GitHub organization of open-source PureScript, Haskell, and TypeScript libraries.

companies.name: doubleAI
companies.description: doubleAI (legal entity AAI Technologies Ltd.) is an Israeli AI research company building Artificial Expert Intelligence (AEI) — AI systems that focus their full training capacity on a single technical domain to match and surpass leading human experts, rather than pursuing broad general intelligence. Its flagship system, WarpSpeed, is an AI GPU performance engineer that optimizes NVIDIA kernels, beating hand-tuned expert baselines on the majority of tested kernels. Founded in late 2023 by Prof. Amnon Shashua and Prof. Shai Shalev-Shwartz and based in Ramat Gan, Israel, the company has raised roughly $221M from Lightspeed, NVIDIA, Michael Dell, Bessemer Venture Partners, Pitango First, and Greenfield Partners at a valuation exceeding $1B. doubleAI publishes research and open-source code but does not currently expose a public developer API.

companies.name: Drexel University
companies.description: Drexel University is a private research university in Philadelphia, Pennsylvania, with roughly 24,000 students and a Carnegie R1 (very high research activity) classification. Drexel is internationally known for its cooperative education (co-op) program, which embeds full-time professional work experience into undergraduate degrees. Core enterprise systems run on Ellucian Banner, surfaced to students and staff through the DrexelOne portal. Drexel does not publish a public developer API, OpenAPI specification, SDK, or open data portal; the organization's GitHub org (drexel-university) currently lists no public repositories, and library, catalog, and IT service pages do not expose documented integration endpoints. This profile is maintained as a tier-3 no-public-API index entry.

companies.name: Humans
companies.description: humans& is a human-centric frontier AI lab founded in 2025 and publicly announced on January 20, 2026, building large-scale AI models centered on people and their relationships rather than raw autonomy. Its research spans long-horizon and multi-agent reinforcement learning, memory, and user understanding, tightly integrating science and product so that AI acts as connective tissue that strengthens organizations and communities. The founding team comes from frontier industry and academic labs including xAI, Anthropic, Google DeepMind, OpenAI, Meta, Reflection, AI2, Stanford, and MIT. Its seed round is led by SV Angel and co-founder Georges Harik, with investors including NVIDIA, GV (Google Ventures), Emerson Collective, Forerunner, S32, DCVC, and Jeff Bezos. As a pre-product research lab it publishes no public API yet; this profile captures its verified public identity surfaces.

companies.name: Imbue
companies.description: Imbue is a San Francisco AI research lab building agentic foundation models for reasoning and the human tooling around them, with a stated mission of AI that is loyal to its user. The team trains large reasoning models in-house (including a 70B model trained from scratch with open-sourced tooling and evaluation datasets) and publishes research on agent and reasoning architectures, reinforcement learning, data generation, and the scientific theory of deep learning. Imbue ships practical tools that emerge from the research, including Sculptor and mngr for orchestrating parallel coding agents, Bouncer for filtering social feeds, and Blueprint and Vet. There is no public commercial inference API; integration happens through open-sourced repositories, model artifacts on Hugging Face, and research releases.

companies.name: National Institute of Food and Agriculture
companies.description: The National Institute of Food and Agriculture (NIFA) provides leadership and funding for programs that advance agriculture-related sciences. NIFA invests in and supports initiatives that ensure the long-term viability of agriculture, partnering with land-grant universities and the broader agricultural research community.

companies.name: Standard Intelligence
companies.description: Standard Intelligence (si.inc) is an aligned AGI research lab based in San Francisco building AI models that explore and learn like humans do. Its work includes hertz-dev, an open-source 8.5B-parameter autoregressive base model for interactive, full-duplex conversational audio; a fully general computer-action model that navigates websites, executes CAD sequences, and drives autonomously at 30 FPS; and The Heap, a 30-petabyte data-storage system built in San Francisco for under $500,000. The company has raised $75M from Sequoia and Spark Capital. It publishes research posts and open-source code on GitHub but does not currently expose a public developer API.

companies.name: Unconventional
companies.description: Unconventional (Unconventional, Inc.) is an AI-hardware research company rethinking the foundations of the computer to optimize energy efficiency for AI.
